Articles 163 and 164 deal with the Council of Ministers.

items: Questions frequently test which specific constitutional articles deal with the Council of Ministers (Articles 163 and 164).
Pay close attention to the principle of collective responsibility: it is specifically to the Legislative Assembly.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 163 and 164 deal directly with the Council of Ministers.
The Council consists of three categories: Cabinet Ministers, Ministers of State, and Deputy Ministers.
The paramount operating principle of the Council is collective responsibility to the Legislative Assembly.
